title: Round-tripping a Model through XKT v12
description: Imports an XKT v12 model into an offscreen SceneModel + DataModel with XKTLoader, exports it straight back to XKT with XKTExporter, then re-imports the exported bytes into the rendered scene. The displayed model is the result of a full XKTLoader → XKTExporter → XKTLoader cycle, demonstrating import/export fidelity.
